semantics.duration_and_inventory: rows preserve provider release duration, initial mass, cumulative outflow, residual mass and residual fraction
semantics.risk_atom_accounting: risk_atom_count counts consequence atoms using the same case key; zero means no atom was linked, not zero physical risk
semantics.promotion: diagnostic trace only; strict release closure, provider qualification, physical validation and facility IR/F-N promotion remain separate gates

frequency_uncertainty.uncomputed_case_policy: facility-assessment uncomputed_cases are copied with explicit status; duplicate rows are preserved, no unsupported accident family is substituted, and no missing case is assigned zero risk

frequency_port_binding.policy: Facility merge preserves reviewed event port_ids in cases and risk_atoms; missing or mismatched rows are withheld and no accident port is inferred; facility QRA also requires every event to have an explicit reviewed port.

frequency_uncertainty.conditional_diagnostic_facility_risk: each scenario reweights the saved risk atoms and exposes a conditional facility IR/F-N diagnostic; incomplete scope, synthetic horizons, and operator limits still withhold a qualified facility total
